pages.text: In order to obtain The Evil Eye, you must defeat the Masquerader, an evil dude looking down upon the ballroom from above. Defeat the party attendees to battle the Masquerader himself.

Sometimes, pillager outposts may have a Mysterious Red Envelope. These are invitations sent out by the Masquerader who is organizing a social event for some other Illagers, primarily outpost captains and other high-ranking Illagers. Open the envelope to reveal an invitation to a masked ball from the Masquerader and a map leading to the venue.
